linkedin.activityText: Daniel Priestley reposted this Daniel Priestley reposted this Charlie Curson Charlie Curson 2d Daniel Priestley reposted this I read Daniel Priestley 's 𝘒𝘦𝘺 𝘗𝘦𝘳𝘴𝘰𝘯 𝘰𝘧 𝘐𝘯𝘧𝘭𝘶𝘦𝘯𝘤𝘦 years ago, put it on a shelf, and mostly forgot about it. Consciously, at least. Then a few years later, as I danced around the ‘find an excuse not to write a book yet’ maypole, Matt Thomas encouraged me to read it again. This time, the stories and the five principles the book is centred around resonated far more. So much so, in fact, that I joined the Dent Global KPI programme in January 2025, and haven’t looked back since. Without diving into the detail of their work, it’s the overriding principles (or 'maxims') that hold everything together and make it as relevant for an early-stage founder as the CEO of an established, eight-figure business. And then there's the community. KPI is an open programme, with people joining from all over the world, all of us putting our best work out there and getting better in public rather than waiting for perfect. 'Progress beats perfection', every time. So thank you, Daniel - and, of course, all your fellow co-founders, coaches and mentors, including Glen Carlson , Mike Reid , Topher Morrison , Sophie Milliken MBE , Karl Schwantes , Donna O'Toole , Lucy McCarraher MBE , Darren Finkelstein (and many others!). And to all the brilliant founders and leaders who continue to support each other on this now-far-less-lonely journey - Cameron Harris , Agnes Cserhati , Lisa Hopper ICF PCC , Olga McCarroll , Liisa Holma , Vincent Grobler , Leonardo Zangrando , Tanner Holt , Herwig Kusatz ))) , Tom Declat , Samantha Davies - and all those I’ve clearly missed! Thank you for the ideas, the challenges, the offers, the partnerships, and the shove when I needed it most. And Daniel, good to finally meet you in person after so many Zoom calls. You were incredibly generous with your advice even stood there with a beer in hand, admiring my bookmark (carefully raised in this photo!). And also even smilier than I imagined. 😁 Daniel Priestley Daniel Priestley 1d Daniel Priestley shared this Dent Global runs the Key Person of Influence Accelerator. First launched in 2010, it is one of the longest running entrepreneur accelerator programs in the UK. It's aligned to a founder-lead growth approach where the business leader is the visible persona associated to the brand. Building a personal brand is part of the program but it goes far beyond that. Participants explore and develop intellectual property, digital assets and become laser focused on an ideal customer persona. There is a huge focus on the creation of a product and service ecosystem that can scale. The strategy is effective because personal brands get 20x more attention than business brands and businesses that formalise intellectual property can scale to bigger markets more effectively. The advice to "niche down" has boxed in more businesses than it's helped. There's a smarter way to focus.
Every business moves through the same four phases – knowing that changes everything.

Which is me?

Tomorrow I'm launching my latest podcast - Book Magic AI. In fact it should be called Book Magic AI AI, as it's an AI podcast which @wavemakersaudio ⁨@lynsaymakeswaves ⁩ - Lynsay and Simon Gould - have developed for me.

As part of my award-winning, AI-assisted book-writing app Book Magic AI⁩ , this 12-episode podcast is also AI-based. The AI ingested the content of my (entirely human) written book, BOOK MAGIC, and the recording of my audiobook, and produced 12 episodes of my words, spoken in a voice so close to mine that I wasn't sure whether I'd recorded it myself when I first heard it!

Listen to this clip - one half is a version human me recorded, and the other half is my AI twin speaking. 

Which do you think is which? 

If you know me, you might well guess - but you have to admit, the likeness is uncanny.

I'm not trying to pretend it's anything other than what it is - an AI-created podcast - but what a brilliant way to get my message across without taking more than a very small amount of my time! Certainly nothing like writing and then recording 12 x 20-minute episodes myself. It was all so easy and such fun to play around with my AI voice until it sounded uncannily like me!

If you're interested in finding out how to create your own AI podcast, message me.

And in the meantime, let me know in the comments which voice is Human Me and which is AI Me - #1 Blue, or #2 Pink. 

And look out for Episode 1 of the Book Magic AI AI podcast tomorrow!
